QF.id: Concept and Role of Mutual Fund_2

question.text: Which of the following is NOT a role played by mutual funds in the economy?

answer.text: Guaranteeing minimum returns to all investors
Facilitating wealth creation for retail investors
Channelizing household savings into capital markets
Acting as a stabilizing force in the capital markets

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 36-37 describe mutual funds as channelling investor wealth/income to entities, supporting economic development and acting as a market stabiliser; page 309 confirms MF investments are not guaranteed or assured return products. The Trap: Mutual funds generally do not guarantee or assure returns. Any guarantee must be specifically stated in the SID and adequately backed as required (page 301), so an absolute "no scheme can ever guarantee" framing is too strong. Note: When setting client expectations, treat returns as market-linked and only describe a guarantee if it is explicitly stated in the SID and properly backed.
